comment: SAM-dependent N-methyltransferase of cladoniamide biosynthesis. Methylates the imide nitrogen (N6) of an indolocarbazole C4c/C7a diol and of an indolo-oxazino-carbazole shunt metabolite.

reactions.description: N6-methylation of an indolocarbazole C4c/C7a diol to give the N-methyl diol
converted further by ClaX2 and ClaM3 to cladoniamides
N-methylation of an indolo-oxazino-carbazole metabolite derived from the C4c/C7a diol
